scope: Every request in the 0x2x05 write, 0x2x07 database-modification, and 0x3xxx control/state namespaces, joined to recovered XDJ-RR callers.

dependencies.filesystem: SavWave resolves the analysis path and writes 400 loud-wave samples plus 100 dot-wave bytes through MstStoreLoudWave and MstStoreDotWave.
No audio decoding is visible; the legacy cue writer mutates cue records and returns the resulting 4702 cue set.
No filesystem access is visible; modTrackRate reads the current Rating and updates it by content ID only when the byte value changes.
SavVbrInf is a constant-success stub in Rekordbox 7.2.19 and does not inspect its message.
Rekordbox recognizes and logs this disc-cue write kind but invokes no writer and sends no reply.
Rekordbox recognizes and logs this delete-all-disc-cue kind but invokes no writer and sends no reply.
Rekordbox recognizes and logs this disc-ID registration kind but invokes no writer and sends no reply.
No filesystem access is visible; modTrackBPM reads the current BPM and updates it by content ID only when the value changes.
SavQtzOfs writes the quantize offset to the analysis path, then mirrors its nonzero state into ContentLink bit zero.
No audio decoding is visible; SavUsbCueExt applies the extended cue mutation and replies through RetNewCueToClient (4E02).
SaveSpecifiedAtomInfo validates the atom and extension, derives a sibling analysis file, and writes it through MstSaveAtomData.
UpdateSpecifiedAtomInfo accepts PQT2 only, derives a sibling analysis file, and updates it through MstUpdateAtomData.

server.rejection_reason: other-client-low-byte routes low byte 0x05 to unsupported-low-byte

interpretation_boundary.rekordbox: Server dispatch and effects come from the pinned Rekordbox vocabulary and its static/live evidence tiers.
interpretation_boundary.xdj_rr: Client call sites describe the pinned XDJ-RR source only. No direct caller does not imply that other player models never emit the command.
interpretation_boundary.effect_class: The coarse class aids navigation; route, target, dependencies, rejection reason, and evidence remain authoritative.
